newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico says 18 ports remain closed due to Josefina.
newsitem.headline: Mexico says 18 ports remain closed due to Josefina.

text.p: At least 18 ports remain closed in Mexico despite the passing of tropical storm Josefina, the communications and transport ministry said on Tuesday.

It said the ports were: Tuxpan, Alvarado, Nuatla, Tecolutla, Tamiahua, Coatzacoalcos, Minatitlan, Tonala and Tlacotalpan in the eastern state of Veracruz; Frontera and Dos Bocas in Tabasco state; and Ciudad del Carmen, Cayo Arcas, Palizada, Campeche, Champoton, Ceiba Playa and Isla Aguada in the south eastern state of Campeche.
Lingering high winds and rains had caused shipping authorities to keep restrictions chiefly on fishing, tourism and pleasure vessels, the ministry said in a statement.
